description: Read people, feedback, goals, tasks and reviews; create goals and post progress updates in Lattice.

lattice_new_feedback_trigger.description: Runs when new feedback is observed in Lattice. Existing records establish the initial baseline. Polling follows your workspace plan; snapshots are limited to 4,000 records.
